prompt: The private Lexkite admin console (Vietnamese labels) used by the small team running Lexkite, a free English-learning app. Feel: calm, confident and premium, data-dense yet airy, as polished as the very best modern SaaS dashboards; built on the Lexkite Kit design system: deep teal brand, one warm coral primary action per view, soft cream light theme ("Bright Day"), rounded tactile cards with a gentle ledge, friendly but grown-up. Rules: every word clearly readable with strong contrast against its own background; no text truncated, clipped or spilling outside its card or table cell; long labels wrap neatly instead of being cut; table numbers right-aligned in their own columns; comfortably large click targets; no photos of real people anywhere (initials avatars or simple flat 2D illustrated icons only); no lorem ipsum; only modest honest sample numbers that fit a young app (a few to a few hundred visitors per day); no invented features, revenue figures, follower counts or growth claims. Wide desktop web layout. Left sidebar with the Lexkite kite logo and nav groups: Tổng quan (Tổng quan, Phân tích, Quảng cáo) · Người dùng (Người dùng, Hộp thư, Thông báo) · Chất lượng (Cảnh báo, Báo lỗi, Chất lượng) · Nội dung & Video (Kênh & phân phối, Video & Social, Video Studio) · Hệ thống (Hạn mức, Kho Drive, Khóa API) · Cài đặt. Slim top bar with the page title, a command search field showing "Ctrl K", a small VI | EN switch and the admin's initials avatar. Sidebar item Tổng quan selected. Screen: Admin › Tổng quan – system health, real humans and automated jobs on one screen. Greeting line "Chào buổi chiều" with today's date. Four KPI tiles with tiny sparklines: Người thật hôm nay 46 (so với hôm qua 39), Người thật 7 ngày 214, Đăng nhập hôm nay 12, Lỗi JS (24 giờ) 2 loại. A "Cần chú ý" card with 3 colored status rows (CI: 1 workflow đỏ trong 24 h; Kho Drive đã dùng 71%; Hạn mức AI 82%). A "Tác vụ tự động" card listing scheduled jobs with green/amber status dots and last-run times. A "Báo lỗi mới" list with 3 short rows. A 30-day line chart card of daily real visitors. Sample numbers are small and honest. Layout: the page must fit a 1280-wide browser window with zero horizontal scroll (flexible widths, nothing wider than the window); every sidebar nav item, tab, chip, table action and icon button at least 44 px tall; every text at least 4.5:1 contrast – small helper text uses the main ink colour, not faint grey; only valid Material Symbols icon names.
